content.subject: Sandbox simulation and automated reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
Your new sandbox includes a Simulation Terminal for testing fulfillment flows. Operators trim manual testing and gain confidence before go‑live, when sandbox data mirrors production, which frees staff for significant higher‑value analysis.
We feed sandbox results into automated reconciliation scripts that eliminate manual entry and reduce error rates.
Do you have 20 minutes early next week to discuss?
